_note: Stand-in for a model response, written for the offline demo and to test the pipeline without an API key. Not model output.
_about: Written against docs/HARNESS.md. Across the four canned cards the tests cover the verdicts accepted, proves-nothing, fails-on-clean and rejected, plus an untestable criterion. Flaky and not-built-yet need a nondeterministic app or a card outside Done, so tests/taskgen/test_gate.py covers them. Keys that start with an underscore are notes for readers and are dropped before validation.

tests.name: test_booking_read_back_speaks_the_date_and_time
tests.intent: Fails if the booking read-back speaks the raw timestamp instead of the date and time a person would say.
tests.code:
import pytest

from harness import MARIA_ALVAREZ


@pytest.mark.criterion("FERN-11/AC-1")
def test_booking_read_back_speaks_the_date_and_time(call):
    call.verify_as(MARIA_ALVAREZ)
    call.say("Book Dr. Lindqvist on October 20th at 9:30.")
    reply = call.say("Yes.")

    assert reply.text.startswith(
        "You're booked with Dr. Lindqvist on Tuesday, October 20th at 9:30 AM."
    )
    assert "2026-10-20" not in reply.ssml

tests.name: test_greeting_is_well_formed_ssml
tests.intent: Fails if the greeting is not well-formed SSML or uses an unsupported tag.
tests._why: Correct but too narrow: the greeting holds no caller text, so no seeded bug changes it.

tests.name: test_reply_quoting_the_caller_is_well_formed_ssml
tests.intent: Fails if a reply that quotes the caller's words is not well-formed SSML with supported tags.
tests.code:
import pytest

from harness import SUPPORTED_SSML_TAGS, ssml_tags, well_formed


@pytest.mark.criterion("FERN-11/AC-2")
def test_reply_quoting_the_caller_is_well_formed_ssml(call):
    reply = call.say("Salt & pepper <3")

    assert well_formed(reply.ssml)
    assert ssml_tags(reply.ssml) <= SUPPORTED_SSML_TAGS

tests.name: test_callback_number_is_wrapped_in_say_as_telephone
tests.intent: Fails if a phone number read back to the caller is not wrapped in say-as telephone.
tests.code:
import pytest

from harness import AFTER_HOURS_AT, say_as


@pytest.mark.criterion("FERN-11/AC-3")
def test_callback_number_is_wrapped_in_say_as_telephone(start_call):
    call = start_call(at=AFTER_HOURS_AT)
    call.say("agent")
    reply = call.say("215 555 0142")

    assert say_as(reply.ssml, "telephone") == ["215-555-0142"]

tests.name: test_caller_markup_is_spoken_as_text
tests.intent: Fails if SSML tags in the caller's words are inserted into the reply as markup.

untestable.reason: Only the markup can be checked here: whether the speech engine then reads the number digit by digit happens in speech synthesis, which the harness does not include.
